title: Belonging
coreMove: Turn inclusion from roster status into durable membership by proving one mistake will not eject someone from the group.
sourcePressure: Defines belonging as durable membership inside the Circle of Safety, where people stop treating hard moments as possible exile and become more candid under pressure.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Making belonging mean warmth, similarity, or social events rather than secure membership with standards intact.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary

exampleSpecs.audience: new volunteer after a missed radio call
exampleSpecs.stakes: one mistake could make him stop reporting uncertainty
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the captain keeps the volunteer inside the circle while replaying the call on the handheld radio
